adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which calls `record_for_host` and performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). This is a DB query per embed request, whereas the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` used an in-memory string setting (app/models/site_setting.rb removed). The new migration creates `embeddable_hosts` without any index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), so lookups can degrade as the table grows; additionally `lower(host)` would require a functional index to be efficiently indexed. This is a concrete performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, not a functional correctness bug.
